name: Agathon
source:
Agathon's parents were murdered in what the police called a random act of violence, but he saw it as a sign of something more nefarious. 

Pushing his only surviving relative, his grandmother Silvia for information, as well as his own research led him to uncover part of the truth. The rest would be revealed after the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Tremere_(VTM)]Tremere[/url] [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Regent_(Tremere)]High Regent[/url] of New York City, [url=/c168834]Aisling Sturbridge[/url] took him in as her retainer, and then eventually [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced[/url] him into the clan. 

Agathon's passion for knowledge and introverted nature make him the perfect scholar, and a valuable asset to the Warlocks.

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
